about: Story sites pinned on the real LOLA terrain by make_terrain.py sites; rules in regions.json. Coordinates: south polar stereographic metres (MOON_ME/DE421), heights above the 1,737.4 km sphere.

aurora.name: Aurora Station (authored outpost) on the Shackleton-de Gerlache connecting ridge
aurora.rule: highest LOLA pixel within 1,500 m of the centre of PGDA Site01 (Connecting ridge, Mazarico et al. 2011 site 1), x = -11,000 m, y = -12,000 m

malapert_summit.name: Malapert relay summit (authored platform at the highest point of Mons Malapert)
malapert_summit.rule: highest LOLA pixel of PGDA Site23 (Malapert massif) within 6,000 m of the USGS/IAU Mons Malapert centre, -85.98 deg, -1.67 deg E

cold_trap.name: Chapter 4 cold trap: a small permanently shadowed basin reached by a ridge road from Aurora
cold_trap.rule: PSR from LPSR_80S_20MPP_ADJ with 0.3 to 6 km2 of area, outside Shackleton, whose slope-limited (<= 12 deg) route from Aurora on the 20 m DEM is closest to 12 km; the site is the lowest PSR pixel
